findings: robot.skills derives named skills from configured policy skills; the withdrawn named skill is removed during upgrade.
robot.do Flamingo reaches queue_skill, which accepts only a name in the loaded policies.skills list. No retired binding means no motion is queued.

The unchanged PADD can still send its former short-Up request; the daemon refuses it because the named model is no longer installed/configured. The existing long-Up drive-mode switch remains unchanged.
The default skill resolver contains fallback kicks and roulade; a perpetual Flamingo policy is not automatically installed by this release.
